scope: 10,000 synthetic records, 12 searches, metadata save and archive load; timing observations with exact count assertions, no performance budget
interpretationLimits: The default initializer completes synchronous mirror synchronization attempts; the harness does not verify every folder or assert the absence of per-record mirror warnings.
Timings are single-host observations, not performance gates. Explicit deferred metadata-only load is separate from full folder generation.
verifiedInitializerBehavior: CaptureStore(root:) uses repairArchiveOnOpen=true and synchronously invokes synchronizeArchive before return; production coordinator requests false for deferred foreground startup.
